findings.evidence: Sprint13B view (sha256 04aeab89022993885cccf5438bb8fe3bf4604be3cdcab751e5f5cdaa1b2e2ce8): line 455 'FOLDS_TO_RUN = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]'; line 563 'N_ALL = len({c for k in FOLDS_TO_RUN for c in HELD[k]})   # every development patient in the planned folds (99)'; line 601 'missing[arm] = [k for k in FOLDS_TO_RUN if k not in done]'. Plan sprint13-question.md: 'An arm is called better (or worse) only if its 98.75% interval against Sprint 12 A1 excludes 0 with all 99 patients scored.'
findings.resolution: UNRESOLVED. Before any execution, freeze 99-patient / five-fold membership independently of the schedule variable, require complete unique baseline+repeat joins over that frozen membership, and reject fold subsets and duplicate/overlapping rows for any non-provisional verdict. Operator decision required; this blocks the verdict rule.
findings.text: The proposed executable derives the verdict cohort (N_ALL = every development patient, intended 99) from an editable driver variable FOLDS_TO_RUN. The plan's verdict rule states an arm is called better/worse 'only if ... all 99 patients scored', but because N_ALL is computed from FOLDS_TO_RUN rather than a frozen 99/five-fold membership, a reduced FOLDS_TO_RUN (e.g. a subset of folds) would still satisfy the 'all N_ALL scored' gate and yield a non-provisional verdict on fewer than 99 patients. The spec carries this as blocker F13B-01; it is a real gap in the proposed code's integrity controls that must be fixed before execution.

findings.evidence: Sprint13B view (04aeab8902...): line 661 'A1, {abs(dd) / y if y > 0 else float(\'inf\'):.1f} times the retraining change'; line 359 note 'train_seed=1 is a pairing label only (nnU-Net training was not seeded)'. Plan sprint13-question.md verdict rule and 'The combined-results cell also prints each difference as a multiple of the retraining change.'
findings.resolution: UNRESOLVED. Remove the magnitude-ratio gate; adopt the conjunctive screen rule (both the vs-A1 and vs-A1_repeat 98.75% intervals excluding zero in the same direction) and record distinct environment/repeat identities. Do not treat one unseeded repeat as a variance estimate. Operator decision required.
findings.text: The proposed combined-results cell reports each arm's Dice difference 'as a multiple of the retraining change' and the plan elevates this into an improvement criterion ('It counts as an improvement only if the same test against A1_repeat points the same way ... prints each difference as a multiple of the retraining change'). The ratio is mathematically ill-posed: the denominator is a single unseeded retraining difference that can be near zero, negative or zero, and the code returns inf in that case. One retraining realization is a point, not a variance estimate (training was unseeded), so the ratio is neither a noise estimate nor a coherent gate. The spec carries this as blocker F13B-02.

findings.evidence: Sprint13B view (04aeab8902...): line 1447 'all_zero = np.all([np.nan_to_num(maps[k]) == 0 for k in maps], axis=0); t = maps["tmax"]'; line 983 'X = np.nan_to_num(X, copy=False, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)   # counted and reported, not silent'. Plan §3 coverage handling: 'statistics use only the brain voxels the perfusion scan covers; uncovered voxels get the outside-brain value 0.'
findings.resolution: UNRESOLVED (suggestion). Bind a label-blind finite/validity policy, coverage provenance and fallback/SD-floor/coverage reporting; keep uncovered output at zero with fixed scoring support. No patient-level coverage audit is authorized in this analysis-only lane.
findings.text: The coverage/validity handling uses an all-four-maps-zero-after-nan_to_num test as a proxy for perfusion coverage. This is only a proxy: a single-channel non-finite value can be coerced to a window-floor value and enter the statistics, and genuinely zero tissue can be excluded, so the proxy does not establish true coverage. The spec carries this as suggestion F13B-03. It is not a verdict blocker but must be bound before interpretation and no patient-level audit is authorized.

findings.evidence: Proposed run spec current/ANALYSIS-SPEC-1.md: 'This is self-review, not opposing review.' and 'Missing: reviewed revised executable, baseline plans/environment receipts, coverage provenance and per-arm time/capacity evidence. Synthetic checks are attributed plan claims, not reproduced.' CHARTER.proposed.md ISLES-071: 'Require source-bound opposing-family review of specification and implementation before a real run.' PROMPTS.proposed.md ISLES-PROMPTS-03: 'A desk review of supplied text does not replace opposing-family review of exact executable bytes.'
findings.resolution: UNRESOLVED. Route the revised specification and the exact revised executable bytes through opposing-family review, and obtain baseline/environment receipts, coverage provenance and per-arm measured timing before any execution authority is considered. Operator review required; no execution authority is granted here.
findings.text: The proposed analysis specification is authored and self-reviewed in the same lane: it states 'This is self-review, not opposing review' and that named missing evidence (reviewed revised executable, baseline plans/environment receipts, coverage provenance, per-arm time/capacity receipts) is absent. Under the campaign and policy, a real run requires source-bound opposing-family review of specification and executable bytes, and desk review of supplied text does not substitute. This is correctly a STOP-for-operator proposal, but the missing opposing review and missing execution/environment receipts are themselves unresolved items that block advancing to execution and must be surfaced to the operator, not only in prose.

rationale: I read the authenticated originals before relying on them and independently verified the spec's load-bearing numeric claims. Verified against evidence hashes: Sprint12-nnunet (ccd74c0e...) lines 469/470/548/698-708 confirm A1 Dice 0.200, no-CTA 0.195, normalized 0.203, normalization +0.003 [-0.015,+0.020], CTA +0.005 [-0.007,+0.016], smoke median 35.69 s/epoch, infarct-in-brain min 83%, the 8.5 min 'skip', and the clipping medians (CBF 8%, Tmax 12%, CTA 10%, CT 10%, CBV 6%, MTT 3%). Sprint12b (7ad63a2b...) lines 7/814-820/842 confirm the primary +0.008 [+0.000,+0.015], 15 predictions/patient (5x3), positive 5/5, lesion F1 +0.009 [-0.004,+0.026], MTT +0.014 [+0.006,+0.021] and 47 exploratory contrasts, and the spec's correct caveat that the printed/rounded-zero lower bound and 'MET' criterion are not independently verified strict positivity on the same exposed patients. Sprint13A aggregates (e5cb1b3e...) confirm P1 +0.003 (97.5% +0.001,+0.004), P2 +0.028 (+0.015,+0.042), same-rule fusion +0.025 (+0.014,+0.038), P2 lesion F1 -0.030, complementarity correlation 0.81 / shared-missed 0.671, and the 0.9187 probability-mask Dice (not the older native-grid >=0.99 check). The cost arithmetic reconciles exactly against the public-price evidence (R, 0175d1c5...): A100-80GB $2.4984/h, composite $3.387168/h and $4.50288/h; 35.69 x 250 x 5 = 12.39 h; and the spec correctly labels estimates versus the single smoke-derived measurement and states it authorizes no spending. The spec answers all eight plan questions, flags the Sprint12b overlap with the correct same-exposed-patients qualification, costs each option with explicit rate/overhead/uncertainty assumptions and scientific model-call estimates, challenges scope (rejects immediate all-arm commitment and the L-size causal framing, defers pnormct and second windows, rejects unbiased-stacking language for 13A), preserves the reserved-cohort and exploratory limitations, and reaches STOP FOR OPERATOR REVIEW with no execution authority and no patient/GPU/Modal/model-call/dispatch work. Its three self-findings (F13B-01, F13B-02 blockers; F13B-03 suggestion) are each independently confirmed in the Sprint13B source (04aeab89...): the editable FOLDS_TO_RUN feeding N_ALL defeats the 'all 99 scored' verdict gate (lines 455/563/601); the magnitude-ratio gate returns inf on a near-zero unseeded retraining denominator and cannot estimate noise (lines 359/661); and the coverage test is an all-zero proxy (lines 983/1447). Because these are unresolved, verified blockers in the proposed executable and the proposal is explicitly self-review lacking opposing-family review and execution/environment receipts, the decision cannot be APPROVE (which requires findings=[]). The correct disposition is to carry these findings forward and stop for the operator. The findings, not this rationale, carry the decision.
